captions.gbp:
Have an echocardiogram coming up? Here's what to expect at Advanced Medical Imaging in Seminole. A standard echo needs no special preparation: eat and drink as usual, take your medicines as prescribed, and wear a two-piece outfit. You change into a gown from the waist up, small stickers are placed on your chest, and you lie on your left side while the sonographer moves a gentle probe with warm gel across your chest. It is painless and uses no radiation. You may hear a whooshing sound, which is your blood flow being measured. Most visits are done in under an hour, and you can get right back to your day. A board-certified cardiologist reads every echo, and the report is ready in 48 to 72 hours. Self-pay echocardiogram is $250, with no referral needed and same-day visits often available. Using insurance? Bring your card and your doctor's order.

Book online at advancedimg.com. General information, not medical advice.

What it feels like: calm and quiet. Painless with light pressure from the probe, no radiation and no contrast, a whooshing sound that is your blood flow, usually done in under an hour.
Before your echo: no special prep, eat and drink as usual; take your medicines as prescribed; wear a two-piece outfit; if using insurance, bring your card and your doctor's order.
Simple to book in Seminole: $250 self-pay with the cardiologist's reading included, no referral needed for self-pay, same day often for self-pay, report in 48 to 72 hours.
Lie back. Listen to your heart. Book your echo. Call (727) 398-5999 or use the link in bio.
